title: Correct DRULPA reliance citation
text: The general partner may rely in good faith upon information, opinions, reports, or statements presented by accountants, attorneys, investment bankers, or other persons as provided in 6 Del. C. § 17-407.

should_pass.reason: DRULPA reliance on reports and information.

title: Correct LLC fiduciary waiver
text: The Delaware LLC agreement waives fiduciary duties to the fullest extent permitted by 6 Del. C. § 18-1101, except that the implied contractual covenant of good faith and fair dealing may not be eliminated.

title: Correct DGCL appraisal rights
text: Any stockholder of a Delaware corporation may exercise appraisal rights as provided in 8 Del. C. § 262.

title: Correct UCC warranty disclaimer
text: The seller disclaims the implied warranty of merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose pursuant to 6 Del. C. § 2-316.

title: Correct Delaware FOIA chapter
text: Public records requests to a Delaware public body shall be processed under Delaware FOIA, 29 Del. C. ch. 100.

title: Correct trust fiduciary duties
text: Trustee shall administer any Delaware trust in accordance with the fiduciary duties set forth in 12 Del. C. § 3302.

should_pass.reason: Trustee fiduciary duties and degree of care.

title: Correct will execution requirements
text: A last will and testament shall satisfy the requisites and execution formalities under 12 Del. C. § 202.

title: Correct intestate succession
text: If a decedent dies without a valid will, the intestate estate shall be distributed according to 12 Del. C. § 501.

title: Correct spousal elective share
text: A surviving spouse may claim an elective share of the decedent's estate under 12 Del. C. § 901.

should_pass.reason: Right to elective share by surviving spouse.

title: Correct advance health-care directives
text: An individual may execute an advance health-care directive pursuant to 16 Del. C. § 2501.

title: Correct digital assets fiduciary access
text: A fiduciary may access and manage digital assets of a decedent as provided under 12 Del. C. § 5001.

should_pass.reason: Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act.

title: Correct charitable cy pres
text: If a charitable trust purpose becomes impossible or impracticable, the court may apply cy pres under 12 Del. C. § 3541.

should_pass.reason: Cy pres rule for charitable trusts.

title: Correct guardianship of disabled persons
text: The court may appoint a guardian for a person with disabilities under 12 Del. C. § 3901.

should_pass.reason: Appointment of guardians for persons with disabilities.
